description: 日志安全与前端可观测：统一脱敏器、日志注入防护、前端统一 logger
creator: nikoniko
notes: Archived with AC-C6/AC-C7 verified only in synthetic browser tests. The real page-unload sendBeacon path and the crash-loop drop rate were not exercised in a real browser session or on RK3568. Parent AC-14 deployment budget signoff stays open: the process-wide defaults (120 req/min, 2 MiB/min, 8 in-flight) are provisional and must not be reported as a signed budget. AC-C4 was narrowed during implementation after the audit premise proved inverted: no production log call site carries an RTSP URL, and the single SanitizeURL consumer writes human-readable audit detail that must stay readable.
